audit_metadata.task: Scientific Validation Closeout & Evidence-Based Readiness Audit
audit_metadata.final_verdict: SCIENTIFIC VALIDATION CLOSEOUT COMPLETE WITH LIMITATIONS

ASTROVISION.qualification_summary: Certified strictly for assisted point-source anomaly triage in interactive viewer. Unattended discovery rejected due to 9.0% empirical FPR and severe sensitivity drop on extended sources (17.4%). Detector 1/2 noise-floor asymmetry documented.

SPECTRA.qualification_summary: Qualified for provisional-null anomaly scoring and interactive SED inspection. 102-band masked AE v2 rigorously controlled false positive rate to 4.88% on blind test set. Validated for unblended point sources; crowded field photometry unvalidated.

CHRONOS-X.certification_status: NOT SCIENTIFICALLY VALIDATED (Secular Transients) / PARTIALLY VALIDATED (Intra-Visit Dither CV Engine)
CHRONOS-X.qualification_summary: Multi-epoch secular transient discovery capability is completely unvalidated on local data due to zero multi-epoch repeat observations (all 599 local pairs are 2.15-6.47 min intra-visit dithers). Computer-vision difference engine (WCS alignment, variance propagation, dipole vetoing) is verified. Strict fail-closed temporal gate blocks false transient promotions.

MOTION-X.certification_status: PARTIALLY VALIDATED (Gaia DR3 Stellar Cross-Matching) / NOT VALIDATED (Moving-Object Tracklets & Asteroids)
MOTION-X.qualification_summary: Gaia DR3 astrometric cross-matching and RUWE stellar vetting are functional and verified. Moving-object tracklet construction and automated asteroid discovery are completely unimplemented stubs. Must not claim minor planet discovery.

FUSION-X.role: Multimodal Evidence Fusion and Candidate Ranking
FUSION-X.qualification_summary: Heuristic multimodal priority ranker validated across 166 automated test fixtures. Provides deterministic anomaly sorting and graceful degradation under missing modalities. Not a calibrated Bayesian posterior probability estimator. Task 1.3M eliminated all legacy bypasses to ensure fail-closed transient gating.

permitted_modes: Sub-Pixel WCS Dither Alignment & Dipole Artifact Vetting
Gaia DR3 Astrometric Cross-Matching & RUWE Vetting
strictly_prohibited_modes: Automated Minor Planet / Asteroid Tracklet Discovery
Presenting Heuristic Priority Scores as Calibrated Physical Probabilities
Unattended High-Stakes Discovery Pipelines Without Human Verification

closeout_verdict_rationale: The scientific validation closeout is complete across all five components with rigorous evidence bases, cohort separation, and frozen checkpoints. However, because local multi-epoch temporal data is physically absent (CHRONOS-X secular validation impossible on local data), moving-object tracklet algorithms are unimplemented (MOTION-X asteroid discovery stubbed), ASTROVISION exhibits elevated D1 false positives and diffuse sensitivity drop, and FUSION-X is a heuristic ranking co-pilot rather than a Bayesian probability model, full unconditional certification is denied. The prototype is certified as 'SCIENTIFIC VALIDATION CLOSEOUT COMPLETE WITH LIMITATIONS' for assisted human-in-the-loop triage in the NASA Space Apps Challenge demo.
